{{Quote|The Force is not fire, it is venom.|Darth Bane|<ref name="BOS" />}}
'''''The Rule of Two''''' was an essay pertaining to an [[Rule of Two/Legends|eponymous doctrine]] authored by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] some time after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Seventh Battle]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. It became the cornerstone of Bane's [[Order of the Sith Lords|reformed Sith Order]] and was passed down from [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] to [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] in the [[Sith archives/Legends|Sith Archives]]. It was eventually included in [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] ''[[Book of Sith]]'' sometime after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is the Rule of Two: One Sith must contain all the power of the dark side. One Master must decide how that power should be used.|Darth Bane|<ref name="BOS" />}}
In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] organization founded and led by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan]], was defeated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Seventh Battle]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the last surviving [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]], decided to restructure the Sith into a [[Order of the Sith Lords|new order]], in which the practices of the Brotherhood were replaced with his own system, the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]. To assert his views, Bane wrote ''The Rule of Two'', a source book detailing his eponymous Sith philosophy.<ref name="BOS" />

That document was conserved in the hidden [[Sith archives/Legends|Sith Archives]] and was passed down from [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] to [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. In the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it fell into the hands of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the Sith alter ego of the [[Politics/Legends|politician]] Palpatine. After the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="BOS" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> ''The Rule of Two'' was handed to the [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], a fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had become Sidious' apprentice under the name of Darth Tyranus. He shared this text with the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] in an attempt to lure and corrupt him. Vos left many annotations in the margins.<ref name="BOS" />

Following the end of the Clone Wars<ref name="BOS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Darth Sidious compiled various seminal Sith texts into his ''[[Book of Sith]]'', and he included Bane's text amongst its sections. It should be noted that Sidious also scrawled notes of his own across the pages.<ref name="BOS" />
